details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is 24.3%, while the predicted answer gives 18.5%, which contradicts the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning: The gold target states that women held 24.3% of national parliamentary seats in Northern Africa in 2021. None of the citations gives that percentage. Citation [1] reports 18.5% for Northern Africa and Western Asia without specifying the relevant year; [3] gives a global figure and Libya's figure, not the Northern Africa percentage; and [8] reports 17.94% for a combined Western Asia and Northern Africa region, for elected seats in a different context. Since the specific 24.3% claim is absent, the citations do not contain all the non-trivial information in the gold target.
